decisionDefinitions.accept-current: Current target preserves source meaning in the pinned caller context.
decisionDefinitions.correction: Current target contains a semantic, grammar, or technical-term error.
decisionDefinitions.refinement: Current target is understandable but has a clear locale or style improvement.
decisionDefinitions.hold: A source-bound ambiguity or unresolved callerless case; none in this window.

placeholderPolicy: Placeholder names and formatter signatures must be preserved as a multiset. No placeholder reordering is needed in this window.
protectedLiteralPolicy: All protected source literals must remain present in reviewed targets. The candidate-free baseline exposed two Hindi API acronym omissions; both are corrected.
numericPolicy: Localized thousands separators are accepted when normalized numeric values remain equal to the English source; raw punctuation differences are recorded separately.
priorHoldPolicy: Carry twelve prior position-3632 hold fingerprints by hash only; do not reuse prior target text as proposals.
